data.name: Ambarish
data.gender_notes: Ambarish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ambarish is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘amba’ meaning sky and ‘rish’ meaning ruler or lord. This name is a reference to the mythological king of the same name who ruled over the heavens. It is a powerful and evocative name, filled with the majesty of the sky and the strength of a ruler. The name Ambarish carries the meaning “Sky-ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ambarish usually hope their child will grow to embody sky-ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine rulership and connection to the heavens.
data.etymology: Ambarish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sky-ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ambarish total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
